S1 MATERIAL — Governing removal/prevention grammar was not widened with the embedded infliction grammar. Introduced by #733 (be867c0d); qualified-list sibling introduced by #734 (28f9a61b). conditionRelations.ts:170,278,295,329. Reproductions at HEAD: "You can end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be magically charmed." -> charmed:applies; "The spell cannot cause you to be magically charmed." -> charmed:applies. Both were mention on origin/main and first become applies in #733. With #734, "You can end one effect on yourself that is causing you to be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened." -> charmed:removes, frightened:applies; the corresponding "The spell cannot cause you to be charmed (if you chose awe) or frightened." -> charmed:prevents, frightened:applies. The bare-condition controls correctly remove/prevent both. Related missed mirroring: "Creatures that cannot be magically charmed automatically succeed on this saving throw." -> prevents rather than the documented immunity/auto-success gate. The direct cannot-be pattern was widened, but negated causation, Stillness-of-Mind's governing end operation, and the immunity-gate alternative retain their old grammar. Authority: mx0d requires building on 30xi's governing grammar; compiler guide sections 4.2/10 require fail-closed reviewed semantic forms; conditionRelations and kindSchemas reserve applies/removes for actual state-effect claims. Closure: keep the governing operation authoritative throughout the admitted adverb/list/qualifier family, including all alternatives, rather than permitting a newly recognized embedded predicate to change removal or prevention into application. Permanent evidence: a generalized positive/control matrix of governing operation x admitted adverb/list qualification x condition order, retaining the exact 30xi and aboleth source regressions. This is a material semantic repair. No committed leaf is wrong from these particular synthetic probes; that limits present reachability/consequence, not the positive classifier contract.

S2 MATERIAL — Condition-list prefixes can cross into another clause's subject. Introduced by #733; expanded by #734's qualifiers. conditionRelations.ts:133,329. "The target is blinded, and frightened creatures can approach it." -> frightened:applies at #733 and HEAD, versus mention at origin/main. This sentence applies blinded to the target and describes already frightened creatures; it does not inflict frightened. Qualified sibling: "The target is poisoned for 5 minutes, and unconscious creatures cannot be targeted." -> unconscious:applies beginning in #734, versus mention in #733. A finite list of condition words does not itself bound a condition-list member: the regex stops at the adjective and never checks the following noun/new subject. This violates the claimed same-predicate/list boundary and the shared-grammar fail-closed requirement, emitting a false positive state-effect relation. Closure: distinguish coordinated predicate/list members from a new noun phrase or clause, or conservatively decline the latter; preserve genuine SRD lists, durations, escape-DC and chosen-option qualifiers. Permanent evidence: generalized discrimination between real condition lists and coordinated clauses with a condition adjective modifying a different subject, including qualified/unqualified first members. Material classifier repair; the pinned pack contains no changed false-positive leaf of this form.

S3 MATERIAL — New non-copular infliction alternatives lack governing-predicate/gate boundaries. Introduced by #734 for subjected/trapped/threshold bullets; #735 (e1e83da3) adds the same class for exiting. conditionRelations.ts:329. HEAD reproductions: "The effect ends early if you are subjected to the petrified condition." -> petrified:applies; "While the target is trapped under the net and restrained, it takes damage." -> restrained:applies. Both first become applies in #734; these are an early-end trigger and an existing-state gate. "If exiting prone, a creature has disadvantage on its next check." -> prone:applies first in #735, although the condition is only a precondition. The threshold alternative likewise reads "The spell cures the following conditions based on current hit points: • 40 hit points or fewer: deafened and blinded." as applying both conditions: it recognizes the bullet while ignoring the governing cure operation. Direct negation controls ("isn't subjected", "is not trapped") do pass, and commas/unsupported qualifiers block several near misses; they do not close the gate/operation boundary. Authority: documented applies vs gates/exclusion/removes semantics and compiler guide 4.2/10. Closure: anchor these positive forms to an affirmative infliction/result operation or exclude subordinate/relative gates, benefit-end triggers, and contrary governing operations; retain the exact Flesh to Stone, Falling Net, Divine Word, and corpse-escape source behavior. Permanent evidence: a generalized matched-form x governing-context matrix, with source-backed positives and genuine near-miss gates/removals. Material semantic repair; no incorrect changed leaf at the pinned pack head is claimed here.

S4 MATERIAL — "release a C creature" incorrectly means removing every possible condition C. Introduced by #735 (07f2190f), conditionRelations.ts:186. "You can release a poisoned creature from the cage." -> poisoned:removes, versus mention before #735. Frightened and unconscious give the same erroneous removal. Releasing a creature from confinement does not cure poison, end fear, or wake it. Speak with Plants supports restrained, not substitution of every condition in MECHANICS_CONDITION_NAMES. Authority: source-grounded bounded grammar and removes' actual-condition-ending contract. Closure: restrict the release inference to source-justified conditions/semantics; fail closed for an incidental condition adjective. Permanent evidence: generalized discrimination across condition families for release-from-confinement, retaining the exact Speak with Plants source regression. Material repair; current committed change to Speak with Plants itself is correct.

S5 MATERIAL — New cure/release removal forms ignore negation of their governing operation. Introduced by #735 (07f2190f), conditionRelations.ts:180-186. "The target is not cured of any effect making it blinded." -> blinded:removes; "You cannot release a restrained creature." -> restrained:removes. Both are mention before #735. The fuller source-shaped "Creatures healed by this spell are not cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened." incorrectly removes both. These alternatives use raw .test and do not apply a governing-negation guard; neither a negated cure nor a forbidden release asserts an operation that ends the condition. Closure: require an affirmative removal operation for the newly admitted forms, with bounded recognition or conservative non-mutating results for negations. Permanent evidence: generalized affirmative-vs-negated governing-operation controls for cure/release, including list alternatives, while retaining Mass Heal and Speak with Plants exact-source positives. Material semantic repair; the four committed mention->removes changes themselves are source-correct.

Aboleth/Dryad/Succubus charm, blindness/deafness choices, the two sense-sharing spells (restricted to own surroundings), swallowed restraint and corpse-exit prone all have affirmative printed support; the same source context remains necessary for timing, targets, choices and restrictions. S7 NON-MATERIAL — Independently reviewed all 64 still-mention leaves using each owning action/trait/record's full prose and condition-bearing sentences. No residual affirmative infliction, immunity, or suppression was found. They are existing-state targeting/eligibility, incapacitated/deafened preconditions, sense/location descriptions, or descriptive invisible objects/forces. Precision about remaining non-infliction mechanics: Animal Shapes, Polymorph, Shapechange and True Polymorph explicitly say the reverted creature isn't knocked unconscious under the stated HP threshold; Vampire Misty Escape replaces falling unconscious with mist. These are protective/prevention-shaped residuals, not evidence of absent mechanics. Kraken Freedom of Movement and spell Freedom of Movement grant a movement-cost escape capability for grappled, also retained as mention. None of these seven leaves changed in the stack. Disposition: no requirement for globally exhaustive positive relation labeling; mention explicitly makes no structured claim, ADR 0020 forbids treating it as absence/safety, and the existing relationship manifest still resolves mention edges and retains the source. This does not excuse S1-S5, which emit affirmative false claims. The inspection also covered all vampire/spawn list targets, harvesting incapacitated creatures, the negated-incapacitated gaze/ability gates, every prone/grappled/charmed target, and every invisible-object/creature-sense leaf.

S8 NON-MATERIAL — Aggregation/consumers: the seven swallowed-restrained leaves (#733: behir, giant-frog, giant-toad, kraken, purple-worm, remorhaz, tarrasque) genuinely both inflict restraint during swallowing and remove it after death. applies winning follows the pre-existing AGGREGATION_PRIORITY; that priority is unchanged. recordRelationshipDeclarations maps every relation to a retained condition edge, including mention; resolveRecordRelationships reads the sibling relation; discovery/expansion traverses resolved edges without filtering for applies/removes, assigns the same related band, and preserves the source record. packet/packetMessage retain authoritative prose alongside typed projections. No consumer depending on the former removes label or immediate state mutation driven by this scalar was found. The trace label changes and remains an aggregate rather than a complete relation set; no current discovery reachability or required corpse-release passage is lost. No requirement for a new multi-relation schema is established by this stack.

S9 NON-MATERIAL — Reproducibility and evidence: independently ran npm run import:dnd5e-srd -- --out /tmp/mx0d-review-pack, then diff -qr against the committed pack directory: byte-for-byte identical for all files, exit 0. Existing aboleth relationship/discovery expectations changed mention->applies in #733 are source-justified, preserve edge/discovery coverage, and are not weakened. Added exact-source/class positives discriminate the intended fixes; controls discriminate several direct negations, ordinary gates and unrelated adjectives, but miss S1-S5. The source-faithfulness/audit gate shares the classifier and cannot independently detect those semantic mistakes. Exact 30xi Stillness removal in both condition orders, Kraken negated causation, Dispel Evil-style prevention, Calm Emotions suppression, immunity gates, and Branding Smite prevention stay intact; the admitted variants in S1 do not. Five focused test files passed, 532 tests total: conditionRelations, rules/conditionRelationships, srdGeneratedPack, importer conditionMechanics, importer mechanicsProjections. Vitest was invoked directly with a /tmp configuration/cache paths, no pretest build or repository writes. Full verify/format/typecheck were not run under the explicit read-only assignment. Final repository git status was clean and HEAD unchanged. All five material findings concern newly admitted false semantic claims; no claim of current automatic game-state corruption or wrong committed leaf is made. Required next state: repair S1-S5 and perform a fresh full review of the materially changed classifier stack; this review bead closes as its reporting deliverable, not approval or closure of any owning implementation bead.
